acceptedDeferral.condition: Deploy the current Nova and Buster images, then run the full Nova-to-Buster production preflight with a real cluster and Tailscale operator.

TSX-OWN-001.rationale: Nova still owns plan resolution and the final gate decision.

TSX-OWN-002.rationale: Buster owns the real exposure capability and imports its evidence into the provider result.

TSX-OWN-003.rationale: The provider and controller are the only active exposure path after legacy deletion.

TSX-INP-001.rationale: A schema-linked deployment fixture replaces unrelated legacy configuration fields.

TSX-INP-002.rationale: The capability checks the declared lease and namespace against live lease data.

TSX-INP-003.rationale: The capability checks the declared Service and port against immutable live lease data.

TSX-INP-004.rationale: The provider rejects endpoints outside the declared namespace Service domain.

TSX-EXP-001.rationale: The controller creates an Ingress owned by the Tailscale ingress class.

TSX-EXP-002.rationale: The capability polls real lease status until the controller reports exposure readiness.

TSX-EXP-003.rationale: The provider returns a typed endpoint with ownership and expiry facts.

TSX-EXP-004.rationale: The capability accepts only canonical HTTPS URLs from controller status.

TSX-EXP-005.rationale: The capability checks the full MagicDNS hostname against operator-approved suffixes.

TSX-EXP-006.rationale: The URL parser rejects embedded credentials, fragments, and noncanonical URLs.

TSX-EXP-007.rationale: The live lease expiry must equal the typed deployment expiry before prepare or release.

TSX-HTTP-001.rationale: Exposure creation no longer mixes transport setup with page-content assertions.

TSX-HTTP-002.rationale: The HTTP provider consumes the typed public endpoint and preserves its default route path.

TSX-HTTP-003.rationale: The HTTP provider retains status, text, content-type, timeout, and response-size checks.

TSX-SEC-001.rationale: Only the Buster capability reads projected Kubernetes credentials.

TSX-SEC-002.rationale: The capability invokes an absolute real kubectl file without a shell.

TSX-SEC-003.rationale: The capability confirms get and patch authorization before exposure mutation.

TSX-SEC-004.rationale: The CRD and controller digest keep lease ownership, Service, access, expiry, and retention immutable.

TSX-SEC-005.rationale: The typed output contains public facts and references but no Secret value.

TSX-LIF-001.rationale: Fixture cleanup patches exposure off before the deployment fixture can release its lease.

TSX-LIF-002.rationale: Cleanup verifies lease ownership and waits for the controller to report Off.

TSX-LIF-003.rationale: Abort signals stop polling and real kubectl execution with a distinct error.

TSX-LIF-004.rationale: A bounded controller-readiness deadline returns a distinct timeout error.

TSX-LIF-005.rationale: The Kubernetes deployment lease remains the final TTL cleanup owner.

TSX-MIG-001.rationale: Project setup moves expected text into the linked generic HTTP test.

TSX-MIG-002.rationale: Project setup creates one HTTP test for each valid legacy smoke path and marker.

TSX-MIG-003.rationale: Project setup converts max_time_seconds to the HTTP request timeout in milliseconds.

TSX-MIG-004.rationale: The HTTP capability uses one bounded deadline for DNS, connection, and response work.

TSX-MIG-005.rationale: The controller provides the current MagicDNS URL instead of trusting a fixed project URL.

TSX-MIG-006.rationale: The provider contract and controller select tailscale-ingress directly, so unknown provider metadata cannot be ignored.

TSX-CUT-001.rationale: The old suite file, protocol token, runner registration, and telemetry branch are absent.

TSX-CUT-002.rationale: Project setup creates the exposure and public HTTP graph or fails when no deployment fixture exists.

TSX-CUT-003.rationale: The real workspace links deployment, exposure, and public HTTP nodes with typed values.

TSX-CUT-004.rationale: The Buster runtime archive includes the exposure provider and its capability runtime.

TSX-CUT-005.decision: Run after the current Nova and Buster images are deployed. Store the successful receipt before closing parity and cutover.
